title: RepoPact 3.1.0 Milestone Release and Research Snapshot Reconciliation

preflight.note: Stamped by `repopact new`; the work item was recorded before implementation began.

acceptance_criteria.text: A concrete 3.0.2-to-3.1.0 compatibility audit is recorded from the live repository and release history, including the stable-tree validation probe, schema/semantic rule comparison, engine protocol compatibility, CLI compatibility, and adopter migration impact; the audit explicitly determines MINOR versus MAJOR before version mutation.

The authoritative milestone inventory reconciles Git history, WI063, WI051, WI022, WI061, WI065, WI046, launch assets, decisions, and evidence, preserving active/incomplete states and distinguishing shipped product, implemented-but-active work, research infrastructure, and completed empirical results.

research/paper.md is reconciled against the final release-candidate SHA with the 3.1.0 identity, current maturity, ROG, assurance mapping, RealRunner, mobile architecture/implementation boundary, release surface, platform evidence, limitations, and research-status claims stated without attributing active or pending work as completed results.

The arXiv preparation sources and metadata are refreshed from an isolated source package, references and figures are verified, research/arxiv/main.pdf is rebuilt and checked, and the durable records continue to state ARXIV NOT SUBMITTED unless separately authorized.

A durable accepted release decision records the compatibility audit and the rationale for RepoPact 3.1.0 as a MINOR release, including optional/additive assurance and ROG capabilities, additive graph protocol/CLI operations, unchanged existing lifecycle/provenance validity, and adopter implications.

All canonical release identities and public/generated surfaces are synchronized to 3.1.0 according to the established rules: VERSION, stable RELEASE_LABEL convention, pyproject package identity, conformance suite_version, Rust engine identity, SPEC, README, CITATION, CONFORMANCE, changelog/release records, and release metadata.

The final candidate passes repository validation, CI verification, release verification, required Python/Rust/frontend checks, conformance, SPEC/dashboard/research freshness, frozen-surface checks, release-surface validation, reproducibility, and artifact inspection without weakening a gate or fabricating platform evidence.

Clean-source release evidence records the pre-release SHA, final release SHA, source/tree identity, platform actually executed, missing platform evidence, build report, release readiness, wheel and sdist hashes, and package inspection results.

After all canonical gates pass, the exact 3.1.0 Python artifact is published through the existing secure credential path, PyPI reports 3.1.0, and a new clean environment installs repopact==3.1.0 from PyPI and passes version/engine, minimal-fixture validation, packaged-resource, metadata, and conformance smoke checks.

The final release commit receives the policy-required v3.1.0 tag and GitHub release if release history confirms that process; notes describe shipped capabilities and explicitly preserve WI063/WI065 active boundaries and ARXIV NOT SUBMITTED status.

After publication/tagging, any continuing development source identity is restored to the established distinct VERSION-pinned development RELEASE_LABEL, and WI021 AC-3 is reconciled only from real publication and clean-install evidence while AC-1, AC-2, and AC-4 retain their actual operator-gated states.
